Avery: RFC follow-up: propose a 'quarantine + tombstone operator' for multi-version API migrations. Goal: shrink blast radius for breaking changes, ensure automated cleanup.

Sam: Can you sketch the lifecycle? Quarantine sounds heavy.

Avery: Lightweight flow: 1) Quarantine: traffic for a tenant routed through a translator shim; 2) Observation window with metrics and testset; 3) Mark tombstone start/ETA; 4) Auto-tombstone operator removes shim after TTL unless owner extends.

Priya: Important: quarantine must be opt-in per-tenant and have an explicit owner tag. Otherwise we get orphaned shims.

Jorge: Operator responsibilities? Detection of idle shims, forced deletion, notification cadence?

Avery: Exactly. Proposal: operator (eng-platform) runs reconciliation loop every 6h. States: pending, active, draining, tombstoned. Transition triggers: timer, manual, or health-failure.

Maya: For streaming endpoints we can't drop framing. Quarantine proxy should expose a shim-preserve-mode header: `X-Shim-Preserve: framing,kv-cache`. Also include version delta in header.

Linh: How do we handle client SDKs vs proxy? Some customers use SDK pinned to v1. We should support three adapter kinds: edge-proxy, runtime-bridge (in-runtime), and sdk-wrapper. Edge-proxy is easiest for opaque clients.

Sam: Telemetry plan: emit `quarantine.{tenant_hash}.latency_ms`, `.error_rate`, `.compat_mismatch`. Use hashed tenant IDs. Also emit `shim.owner` tag on spans.

Priya: Rollout policy: canary cohorts -> expose `quarantine.cohort` label. Ops rule: if `.error_rate` > 1.5x baseline for 15m, mark draining and rollback.

Jorge: Cleanup rules: default TTL 21 days after tombstone scheduled, notifications at 14/7/3/1 days. tombstone-bot will DM owner with cleanup link. If owner missing, operator escalates to eng-platform rotation.

Avery: Security: don't persist raw request bodies in quarantine events. Use event sampling + PII scrubber pipeline. Hash tenant and request IDs for correlation.

Maya: Tests: add integration job `quarantine-integration` that runs synthetic streaming traffic, verifies framing preserved, and ensures KV cache headers propagate. Also unit test for header negotiation parsing.

Sam: Implementation notes: keep shim path shallow to avoid extra hop penalty. Target <2ms median overhead. Kernel: proxy uses mux-less passthrough when no translation required.

Linh: Can operator auto-rollback if it detects significant latency regression? We should allow automated rollback with annotation to issue.

Priya: Yes: operator policy support: `autoRollbackOnLatency=true|false`, threshold config per-tenant. Default false for high-SLA tenants.

Avery: Action items:
- Sam: spike edge-proxy shim with preserve header (PR incoming) -> due Mon EOD
- Linh: sdk-wrapper proposal doc (compat surface + telemetry) -> Wed
- Priya: tombstone operator runbook + notification templates -> Wed EOD
- Jorge: implement scrubber + hashed IDs for telemetry -> Tue
- Maya: add streaming test harness and CI job -> Fri

deploy-bot: deploy request: `quarantine/edge-proxy:canary` -> staging at 1728301300 :rocket:

Sam: pushed branch https://git.internal/r/redwood/quarantine/edge-proxy/pull/7 :eyes:

Avery: One more policy ask: all shims must expose a `shim-version` and `shim-commit` header and report health to `/v1/shepherd/health`. Helps for debugging.

Maya: +1. Also include `compat-testset` run against both versions on PRs.

Linh: No strong objections. Concern: operator complexity increases. We should start small—edge-proxy only for first phase.

Avery: Agreed. We'll iterate operator features as we learn. I'll capture notes and update the RFC.

Priya: Booking a 30m sync Thu 11:00 to review canary metrics; invite list: Avery, Sam, Linh, Maya, Jorge.

Jorge: Minor nit: ensure tombstone auditing for billing so customers don't get charged for orphaned shims.

Avery: Good catch. Add billing check to operator pre-delete hooks.

Sam: starting the prototype now. Will include latency budget and simple SLO in PR description.

Avery: Thanks all.
